title: Objective and Perceived Quality Study in Patients Undergoing Elective Groin Hernia Surgery
brief_summary: This is a prospective non-comparative observational study of cohorts. Consists on offering surveys to every patient undergoing groin hernia surgery in our Abdominal Wall Surgery Unit, in Hospital of Navarra.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients entering surgical waiting list during a year (from March 1st, 2018, to February 28th, 2019).
* Elective surgery.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age below 16.
* Mental diseases.
* Patients not capable of understanding the study.
* Patients that reject entering the study.
study_population: Patients undergoing elective inguinal hernia surgery en Pamplona
